svg.text: 1. Identity budget = f × 100 ms (f = 0.5 working assumption; results for f ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}). P*(f) = floor(f·100 ms / t) = neighbours serviceable per

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: interval; viable in dense traffic when P* ≫ 100.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 2. t_eff(k) = 0.428 + 10.52/k ms fits the k ∈ {1, 5, 25, ∞} sweep within ±7 % (#32). On a second host with t_local ≈ 0.5 ms no k reaches P*(0.5) = 100

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: (#37): the knee is host-dependent and is always quoted with its t_local.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
